rules.rule: Headless REST + SSE server. Check axum routing, SSE frame contract (snapshot then live tail, monotonic ids), request validation, error-to-HTTP-status mapping, multipart/thumbnail handling, and that no Tauri/desktop assumption leaks in.
Pipeline engine for a headless server. Verify stage scheduling and ordering, subprocess handoff and memory release, resource accounting, cancellation/timeout, and correctness under concurrency.
ML inference. Check tensor shape and lifetime correctness, device selection (cpu/gpu), error propagation, and that no GUI-only or window-system assumption is required.
Process entrypoint with gui/headless cargo features. Verify the feature gates are exhaustive and correct, that the headless path never touches Tauri, and that flag parsing and exit codes behave.
Build script gated on the gui feature. Verify tauri_build only runs for gui and that a headless-only build never requires Tauri or its frontend assets.
